name: vertex-abap
description: ABAP Version, Code and Data Explorer - the VERTEX pages under a VS Code host

vertex.url.markdownDescription: Base URL of the ABAP system, for example `https://host.example.com:44300`.

vertex.client.description: SAP client, sent as sap-client. Leave empty to use the system default.

vertex.user.description: SAP user. The password is asked once and kept in the OS credential store.

vertex.allowInsecureCertificate.markdownDescription: Accept a server certificate that cannot be verified. Development systems often have one. **Off by default on purpose** - turning it on disables certificate checking for this extension's requests.
